sourceEvidence.title: Director, Quality Engineering
sourceEvidence.quote:
**Required Qualifications:**
**Education and Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a closely related technical discipline.
* At least 10 years of progressively responsible, hands-on experience in medical-device quality engineering or closely related engineering roles, supporting both new product development and sustaining or manufacturing activities.
* Demonstrated experience managing engineering personnel, setting technical direction, and developing team capabilities.
* Experience working with external suppliers or contract manufacturers on technical qualification, process controls, investigations, and improvements.

* Experience with orthopedic implants, surgical instruments, and associated manufacturing processes, including applicable ASTM and ISO test standards.
